verdict.rationale: Fellow publishes its own API reference at developers.fellow.ai, with per-endpoint pages backed by an OpenAPI 3.1 document on ReadMe's registry. However, no evidence shows the reference is interactive or offers runnable examples, and no sandbox or test workspace is documented for safe experimentation. missing for 10: documented interactive try-it console, runnable code examples, sandbox/test environment, a Fellow-hosted OpenAPI path (probes 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
